mapper.select: SELECT rooms.room_id, rooms.freelancer_id, rooms.project_id, rooms.freelancer_exited, rooms.client_exited, p.title, u.name, u.profile_image_url, u.user_id AS opponent_id, CASE WHEN m.is_deleted = 1 THEN '삭제된 메시지입니다.' WHEN m.file_name IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('📎 ', m.file_name) ELSE m.content END AS last_message_content, m.sender_id AS last_message_sender_id, m.created_at AS last_message_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m3 WHERE m3.room_id = rooms.room_id AND m3.sender_id != #{loginUserId} AND m3.is_read = 0 ) AS unread_count FROM chat_rooms rooms JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = rooms.project_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = ( CASE WHEN rooms.freelancer_id = #{loginUserId} THEN p.client_id ELSE rooms.freelancer_id END ) LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.message_id = ( SELECT m2.message_id FROM messages m2 WHERE m2.room_id = rooms.room_id ORDER BY m2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE (rooms.freelancer_id = #{loginUserId} AND rooms.freelancer_exited = 0) OR (p.client_id = #{loginUserId} AND rooms.client_exited = 0) ORDER BY COALESCE(m.created_at, rooms.created_at) DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_rooms r JOIN projects p ON r.project_id = p.project_id SET r.freelancer_exited = CASE WHEN r.freelancer_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE r.freelancer_exited END, r.client_exited = CASE WHEN p.client_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE r.client_exited END WHERE r.room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.room_id, r.project_id, p.title, u.user_id AS opponent_id, u.name, u.profile_image_url FROM chat_rooms r JOIN projects p ON r.project_id = p.project_id JOIN users u ON (CASE WHEN r.freelancer_id = #{loginUserId} THEN p.client_id ELSE r.freelancer_id END) = u.user_id WHERE r.room_id = #{roomId}
